description: This Java class 'ModelNotification' manages notification configurations, including sending notifications based on events, building notification contexts, and retrieving notification group details from configuration.

classes.name: ModelNotification
classes.description: Represents a notification model that can trigger notifications based on events, build notification contexts, and retrieve notification group details.

methods.name: getNotificationGroupName
methods.description: Returns the name of the notification group.

methods.name: setNotificationGroupName
methods.description: Sets the name of the notification group.

methods.name: callNotify
methods.description: Triggers notification if the event matches, executing a notification service with a built context.

methods.name: buildContext
methods.description: Constructs the context map for the notification, including recipient addresses, subject, and other parameters.

methods.name: buildTo
methods.description: Builds the 'to' address list for notification.

methods.name: buildCc
methods.description: Builds the 'cc' address list for notification.

methods.name: buildBcc
methods.description: Builds the 'bcc' address list for notification.

methods.name: getCommaSeparatedAddressList
methods.description: Retrieves comma-separated list of addresses for a given notification type.

methods.name: getAddressesByType
methods.description: Gets list of addresses from a NotificationGroup by type.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the notification subject from the notification group.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the screen URI for the notification.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the service name to trigger for the notification.

methods.name: getNotificationGroup
methods.description: Fetches a NotificationGroup by name from the service configuration.
